pricing.title: Start for free and change plans when you need to.
pricing.lead: No trial period and no lock-in. The free plan doesn't expire.

free.storeMethods: Store with Pix, card and Drive

pricing.mpFees: Mercado Pago charges its own fees (3.79% on Pix, about 5% on card), paid by the seller with any tool.

payout.q: Does the money go to my Mercado Pago account?
payout.a: Yes. You connect your Mercado Pago account in the panel, and the payment lands straight in it, with the platform fee deducted on the spot. We don't have access to your balance.

saleFee.q: How does the per-sale fee work?
saleFee.a: On the Free and Pro plans, we charge R$ 1 per confirmed sale, or at most 10% of the price, whichever is lower. On Pro Max the fee is R$ 0. Mercado Pago's fees (about 3.79% on Pix and 5% on card) are separate and paid by the seller, as with any tool.

chargeback.q: What if the buyer asks for a refund?
chargeback.a: It follows Mercado Pago's normal process: you get a notice in the panel, and the bot undoes the delivery (removes the role or the access). The money goes back through Mercado Pago itself.

card.q: Do I need a credit card to get started?
card.a: No. The Free plan already includes the store with Pix, card and Drive, is free forever and doesn't ask for a card. Pro only makes sense when you want monthly subscriptions, like a recurring VIP role.

fivem.q: Does it work with FiveM or roleplay servers?
fivem.a: Yes, it's the most common use. Besides selling VIP and channel access, the FiveM module links the player's account, manages allowlist and queue by role and runs in-game actions after the purchase. There's also an MTA integration.

cancelPro.q: If I cancel Pro, do I lose sales or data?
cancelPro.a: No. Store, history and settings stay as they are, and you go back to Free selling as usual. Only recurring subscriptions stop renewing. You can export your data whenever you want.

openSource.a: No. But new features are decided together with the community on our Discord.
